product_family: Pecan AI is a SaaS predictive AI analytics platform that automates machine learning workflows for business teams. Core product includes churn prediction, customer lifetime value modeling, lead scoring, demand forecasting, upsell/cross-sell identification, customer winback, fraud prevention, and campaign ROAS prediction.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Pecan is certified under ISO 27001, a globally recognized standard for managing Information Security Management Systems.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: undergoes annual independent assessment covering security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR ready; data residency under European Commission's Adequacy Decision regarding Israel; external transfers protected via contractual commitments

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence of HIPAA compliance or certification

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence of PCI DSS compliance

privacy.ai_training_note: Explicit policy: customer data is not used for any purpose other than generating predictions for that specific customer. Data is not copied, transmitted, or used for model training. Customers control which fields/entities are imported.
privacy.data_region: AWS primary infrastructure; not explicitly locked to US or EU region. Supports Israel data residency under EU Commission Adequacy Decision.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Signed and encrypted access tokens; TLS for network communications

security.name: Network Security
security.value: Secure 2FA-enabled VPN with active firewall protection

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Minimum 8-character passwords with numbers and symbols; account lockout after 10 failed sign-in attempts

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Restricted to authorized IT, DBA, DevOps personnel, and customer success managers on need-to-know basis

security.name: Monitoring & Detection
security.value: Comprehensive monitoring and SIEM controls for suspicious activity detection

security.name: Data Deletion
security.value: All data destroyed upon deletion of prediction jobs or schedules

security.name: SDLC
security.value: Follows OWASP Secure Software Development Life Cycle best practices

products.name: Pecan AI Platform (SaaS)
products.data_scope: Customer business data (no PII required); raw or prepared data for predictions
products.notes: Primary offering; cloud-hosted; multi-tenant infrastructure on AWS; supports integration with CRM, data warehouse, and BI tools; data not trained on or used beyond prediction generation

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription (pricing not publicly detailed; contact for demo)
compare.data_residency: AWS primary; Israel data residency available under EU Adequacy Decision
